scope: Challenge-specific organizer answers supplied by the author; not replacements for the Radio Regulations or confirmation of case applicability.

rules.answer: Protect RX, with TX fallback; retain station number and raw bandwidths. Select the smaller channel/transmission bandwidth on mismatches. Missing licence class may be labelled MUUT.
rules.gap: Register coordinates and reception areas still require case review.

rules.answer: RR PFD limits are the main source; assume full gain towards Finland. Finnish reception includes TX coverage and licence-exempt M4 use, not only Excel point sites.
rules.gap: Stored GSO point screening exists; full M4 coverage, service/footnote applicability, non-GSO and AP30-family protection are incomplete.

rules.answer: Use T/R 25-08 A1.2.3; above 470 MHz use the general above-400 MHz criterion for this challenge. P.1546-6 is acceptable; the practical receiving-height correction is not required.
rules.gap: Offline criterion gates exist. Actual-path field strengths and per-case ERP/spectrum/height validation are not established.

rules.answer: Assess Finnish land borders and the outer territorial-sea limit, concentrating on closest/high-field sections; flag exposed Finnish stations. A national Space evaluation grid is accepted. Name the geographic sources used.
rules.gap: National-footprint and territorial-sea samples exist; footprint boundaries are not a verified land-border-only layer. Full terrestrial border-section evaluation is missing.

rules.answer: Review margins may be team-defined, documented and easily modifiable. No synthetic-data band deserves preferential priority.
rules.gap: Buffers order review only and do not change regulatory limits or historical artifacts.

rules.answer: Reported coordination with Finland must be verified against the national register. Calculated threshold exceedances remain review cases even if coordination or favourable BR findings are reported.
rules.gap: Reported provisions are retained; national agreement records and verified real-case comparisons are unavailable.

rules.answer: Submit separately readable Space 3074 and Terrestrial 3076 results; CSV/XLS or document exports are preferred, with machine-readable technical evidence welcome.
rules.gap: Provided CSVs are frequency-review outputs, not complete calculated concern benchmarks or a measured accuracy score.
